versions.changelog:
- Added detailed documentation for generating eNSP topology (.topo) files from user requests.
- Outlined supported device types (routers, switches, firewalls, wireless, endpoints) and connection types.
- Described the auto-layout algorithm for device positioning in topologies.
- Provided guidance on adding text labels and area boxes for enhanced diagrams.
- Clarified standard output format, file naming, and how users should open results in eNSP.
